# GoFLE

> Fast Interactive Log Explorer — a cross-platform desktop app (Go + Wails v2) for
> browsing, searching, and tailing very large local and remote (SSH) log files.

## Overview

GoFLE is a re-implementation of the classic [glogg](https://github.com/nickbnf/glogg)
log explorer concept. The backend (file indexing, parallel search, SSH streaming) is
Go; the UI is TypeScript + Vite rendered in a native webview. It is read-oriented:
you open, search, copy, and export logs but never edit them.

## Project type

Application: a desktop GUI binary (`GoFLE`) and a terminal companion (`gofle`,
in `cmd/gofle`) that share one Go backend. Module path: `GoFLE`. Go 1.26.
Depends on `github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2`, `github.com/spf13/cobra`,
`github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea`, and `golang.org/x/crypto`.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md) — features, architecture, build/run, usage, security notes
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — build, test, and PR workflow
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — user-facing changes (Keep a Changelog format)

## Packages

| Path | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `pkg/config` | App settings, recent files, AES-GCM SSH secret encryption, session persistence. Single source of truth for persisted state. |
| `pkg/indexer` | `FileIndexer`: builds a byte-offset index, random line access via `pread`, live tail (`UpdateIndex`), and a zero-copy `ScanLines` hot path for search. |
| `pkg/search` | `SearchEngine`: parallel regex/substring search over a line range, case-sensitivity, invert-match; caches the compiled regex for the tail poller. |
| `pkg/ssh` | `Streamer`: streams a remote file over SSH to a local temp file, tails it every 2 s, verifies host keys via OpenSSH `known_hosts`. |
| `pkg/remote` | Shared transport contract: `Streamer`/`Lister` interfaces + unified `Config`. `pkg/ssh` and `pkg/ftp` implement these; the app and indexer depend only on `remote`. |
| `pkg/ftp` | `Streamer`/`Lister` over FTP/FTPS (explicit/implicit); pins the server certificate in the `ftp_certs` trust store. |
| `pkg/logging` | Centralized `slog` setup for both binaries (stderr + `gofle.log` beside the config dir). |

## Entry points

- `main.go` — Wails app options, `//go:embed all:frontend/dist`, window lifecycle.
- `app.go` — `App` struct bound to the frontend; tab lifecycle, 500 ms tail poller,
  search orchestration, SSH open/accept flow, settings & session persistence.
- `cmd/gofle/main.go` — `gofle` CLI entrypoint: wires the cobra command tree
  (`version`, `ssh`, `ftp`, `list`, and the root `gofle [target]` viewer open),
  installs SIGINT-scoped cancellation, and maps failures onto exit codes
  (2 = usage error, 1 = runtime error).

## CLI Companion

`gofle` is a terminal companion that reuses the same Go backend as the desktop
app to open a log — local, or over `ssh://` / `ftp://` — in an interactive
Bubbletea viewer. Build it with `go build ./cmd/gofle` (the module path
`GoFLE` is not proxy-resolvable, so `go install` does not work). Commands:
`gofle [target]`, `gofle version`, `gofle ssh [flags] <host>`,
`gofle ftp [flags] <host>` (`--tls explicit|implicit` for FTPS), and
`gofle list` / `gofle list open <n>` / `gofle list clear`. The viewer exposes
scroll, `/` search, `n`/`p` match nav, `[`/`]` first/last, `r` results-only,
`f` follow, `g` goto, `e` export, `?` help, and `q`/`Ctrl+C` quit.

## Key invariants (for contributors / agents)

- A tab maps 1:1 to a file (local path or `ssh://host:port/path`); re-opening
  focuses the existing tab.
- `frontend/dist` must exist before any `go build`/`go test` (embedded by Go).
- SSH secrets are encrypted at rest with AES-GCM; the key lives in `secret.key` (0600).
- The frontend owns the session snapshot (order/groups); Go never rebuilds it.
- Concurrent access uses `sync.RWMutex` in `App`, `FileIndexer`, `SearchEngine`,
  `AppConfig`; the tail poller runs search without holding `tab.mu`.
- Remote transports (ssh, ftp) sit behind the shared `pkg/remote` `Streamer` /
  `Lister` interfaces; the app and indexer depend on `remote`, never on
  `pkg/ssh` or `pkg/ftp` directly (avoids an import cycle).
- SSH host keys are pinned in OpenSSH `known_hosts`; FTPS server certificates are
  pinned in `ftp_certs` (one `host:port <sha256-fingerprint>` line per host). An
  unknown key/cert is confirmed before being trusted; a changed one is rejected
  as a possible MITM.

## Build & test

```bash
cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ..
wails build
go test ./... && go vet ./... && golangci-lint run
```

Reproducible multi-platform build: `./build.sh` (Docker).

## Native-build prerequisites (important for agents)

- **Go 1.26+**, **Node.js 18+** (npm), and the **Wails CLI v2**
  (`go install github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails@latest`).
- **Linux**: CGO must be enabled and the GTK/WebKit system libraries installed
  (`libgtk-3-dev`, `libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev`, plus `pkg-config`/build tools).
- macOS: Xcode command-line tools. Windows: a C compiler + the WebView2 runtime.
- `frontend/dist` must exist before any `go build`/`go test` (embedded by Go).

## Packaging caveat

There is **no** repo-root `install.sh` / `GoFLE.desktop` packaging step to recommend.
Build the app with `./build.sh` (→ `./GoFLE` at the repo root) or a raw
`wails build` (→ `build/bin/GoFLE`) and run the resulting binary directly. A Linux
install helper exists at `scripts/install.sh` and generates the `.desktop` entry at
install time; do not assume a committed `GoFLE.desktop` or a root-level `install.sh`
is present.
